example.title: US Coast Guard Station Tillamook Bay boathouse (1942) and station, Garibaldi

brief: A coastal lifeboat station: the 1942 boathouse standing on piles out in the bay, a big two-storey gabled building of dark brown shingle with rows of white-trimmed windows, a steep dark roof with ventilators, a lettered board ('Pier's End') on the gable and a launchway on piles; ashore, the white station building with a small lookout cupola behind a brick sign pier lettered 'Coast Guard'. Two photos. Older than 1970: the only West Coast lifeboat station on Commons with photos of its buildings is this 1942 one. Foundations and piles taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
